card.name: Quality and standards wording
card.fires_on: The word quality, or words right before it such as consistent, standards, threshold and consistency, in text about maintaining or vouching for quality. Also on 'of' just after quality.

modes.label: The word quality
modes.description: Quality itself, in disclaimers or statements about maintaining it.
modes.example: We cannot attest to the<< quality>> of any of the services listed by those

modes.label: Words leading into quality
modes.description: Words that set up a quality or standards noun next, such as consistent or standards.
modes.example: need for increased supervision to maintain<< consistent>> quality in the packed product.

modes.label: Review and endorsement wording
modes.description: Verbs and nouns about reviewing, endorsing or setting a bar for content.
